description: This file defines classes and templates for handling asynchronous completion callbacks, primarily for testing purposes within the Chromium project. It includes classes for waiting on asynchronous results, managing callback invocation, and ensuring buffers are not referenced after callback execution.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallbackBase
classes.description: Base class for testing completion callbacks, providing mechanisms to wait for results.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallbackBaseInternal
classes.description: Internal base class managing the wait loop and result state.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallbackTemplate
classes.description: Template class for handling asynchronous callback results, with specializations for different result types.

classes.name: TestClosure
classes.description: Class providing a closure that sets the result, used for testing callback invocation.

classes.name: TestCompletionCallback
classes.description: Concrete class for int result callbacks, used in tests.

classes.name: TestInt64CompletionCallback
classes.description: Concrete class for int64_t result callbacks, used in tests.

classes.name: ReleaseBufferCompletionCallback
classes.description: Callback class that ensures an IOBuffer is not referenced after callback execution.

methods.name: WaitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the asynchronous operation to complete and returns the result.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns the result if not pending, otherwise waits for completion.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Returns a callback bound to set the result.

methods.name: closure
methods.description: Returns a closure that sets the result when invoked.

methods.name: SetResult
methods.description: Sets the result and signals completion.
